row.title: LANE-LATENCY-1: 3 minute PR latency probe that merges the stuck PR
row.body: lanewatch default threshold 30 to 3 minutes and --remediate merges a green stuck PR on its exact head; checks tests split in two halves; session reaper idle TTL 0.17 hours.
